brief:
Settlers on Saturday intensified attacks against Palestinian residents and their property across multiple locations in the occupied West Bank, the Shehab Wire reported. The incidents marked a continuation of settler violence that has persisted throughout the territory in recent weeks.

The escalation occurred as settlement expansion and land seizures by Israeli settlers accelerated in the West Bank. Palestinian communities in scattered areas reported damage to homes, agricultural land, and other assets. The new outpost establishment represents another phase in the broader campaign of territorial encroachment that has displaced numerous Palestinian families and communities from their holdings.
